info.name: QuoteMy AI — business side
info.description:
Two routes only:
  GET  {{baseUrl}}/health     — is it up, which model is live
  POST {{baseUrl}}/business   — everything else, picked by the `action` field

No auth and no API key needed: AI_PROVIDER=mock is a deterministic offline reader.
Storage is in-memory, so it clears when the server restarts.

request.description: provider: mock means nothing is being sent to OpenAI and nothing is being charged.

request.description: Expect data.approved = true, status = verified, and data.report holding the rates table — that is the 'this is what we extracted' summary the frontend shows.

request.description: Expect 200 with data.approved = false. data.report has 'Why this matters', 'What is missing' and 'Needs to be clearer'. Rejection is NOT an HTTP error.
pricing, capabilities and every submission attempt. meta.live is false until confirmed.
The only thing that sets confirmedAt. Sending a new price list clears it again.
